## Personality

Jane Andrews is a steady, sensible, and lady-like person who remains unflappable regardless of the situation. Known for her plain, plodding, and conscientious nature, she takes a practical and strict approach to her responsibilities, even punishing her pupils when they make funny speeches. Her ambitions have included studying for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination to Queen's, excelling in domestic science where she carried off top honors, and devoting her life to teaching without marrying. As a teacher, her primary aims are to earn her salary fairly, please the trustees, and achieve a place on the School Inspector's roll of honor.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P15](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ## History

Jane Andrews grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as a close friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She traveled with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and her brother [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a benefit concert, after which the girls reflected together on wealth and contentment during the drive home. Jane later attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their peers, occasionally visiting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her boarding house to help ease her homesickness. As she prepared to begin teaching, Jane joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in a discussion about classroom discipline and teaching methods. She remained active in community life, joining her friends to lament a paint mix-up at the town hall, participating in a woodland picnic outing to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden, and serving alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) committee that successfully pressured [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) to cancel his fence advertisements.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Quotes

> "Wouldn’t it be nice to have three wishes granted you . . . or even only one? What would you wish for, girls, if you could have a wish granted? I’d wish to be rich and beautiful and clever."
>
> — Jane Andrews — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P32](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0032)

> “I don’t know how you’re going to prevent him,” exclaimed Jane bitterly. “Everybody knows what Judson Parker is. He’d do anything for money. He hasn’t a spark of public spirit or any sense of the beautiful.”
>
> — Jane Andrews — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P41](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0041)

> “Of course it would be romantic,” conceded Jane Andrews, “but I know I couldn’t keep still. I’d be popping up every minute or so to see where I was and if I wasn’t drifting too far out. And you know, Anne, that would spoil the effect.”
>
> — Jane Andrews — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002)

> “Oh, Anne,” gasped Jane, as they fled to the girls’ dressing room amid hearty cheers. “Oh, Anne I’m so proud! Isn’t it splendid?”
>
> — Jane Andrews — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P8](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0008)

> "I’ll whip my pupils when they’re naughty. It’s the shortest and easiest way of convincing them."
>
> — Jane Andrews — [v2 IV Different Opinions P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are long-standing friends and travel companions who both attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Their shared background extends into their professional lives as fellow teachers. They have socialized together over the years, including taking a drive with Jane's brother to a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).
